cases.explain: The verb 'рассеять' (to scatter) takes the accusative case for animate plural objects
Nominative case for the subject of the verb 'развеивается' (disperses)
Nominative case for the subject of the verb 'тает' (melts)

cases.translation: let them rejoice before God's face
cases.explain: The preposition 'перед' (before, in front of) takes the instrumental case
The preposition 'на' (on, at) for location requires the prepositional case
The verb 'петь' (to sing) with the meaning 'to sing to someone' takes the dative case
The verb 'признать' (to acknowledge) takes the accusative case

cases.translation: giving power and strength to the people
cases.explain: The participle 'дающий' (giving) takes the dative case for the recipient

reading.ru: Да восстанет Бог, да рассеет своих врагов, да побегут от его лица ненавистники его
reading.question: What should happen to God's enemies?
options: They should prosper and become strong
They should be scattered and flee from Him
They should build cities and temples
reading.correct: They should be scattered and flee from Him
reading.explain: The text says God should 'рассеет своих врагов' (scatter His enemies) and they should 'побегут от его лица' (flee from His face)

reading.ru: Подобно тому, как развеивается дым, развей их, как тает воск от огня, пусть пропадут нечестивые от лица Божьего
reading.question: How are the wicked compared in this verse?
options: To smoke dispersing and wax melting from fire
reading.correct: To smoke dispersing and wax melting from fire
reading.explain: The text uses two comparisons: 'как развеивается дым' (as smoke disperses) and 'как тает воск от огня' (as wax melts from fire)

reading.ru: Отец — сирот и защитник вдов, Бог — в святом жилище Своем
reading.question: What roles does God have for the vulnerable?
options: He is Father to orphans and protector of widows
reading.correct: He is Father to orphans and protector of widows
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Отец — сирот и защитник вдов' (Father of orphans and protector of widows)

reading.ru: Бог дает одиноким дом, выводит узников и дает им преуспевание
reading.question: What blessings does God give to the afflicted?
options: Homes to the solitary, freedom to prisoners, and prosperity
reading.correct: Homes to the solitary, freedom to prisoners, and prosperity
reading.explain: The text says God 'дает одиноким дом' (gives homes to the solitary), 'выводит узников' (brings out prisoners), and 'дает им преуспевание' (gives them prosperity)

reading.ru: Благословен Владыка, ежедневно Он возлагает на себя наше бремя, Он Бог, спасающий нас
reading.question: What does this verse emphasize about God?
options: God daily bears our burdens and is our saving God
reading.correct: God daily bears our burdens and is our saving God
reading.explain: The text says 'ежедневно Он возлагает на себя наше бремя' (daily He bears our burden) and 'Бог, спасающий нас' (God, our savior)

reading.ru: Грозен ты, Боже, в своем святилище, Бог Израиля, дающий могущество и силу народу
reading.question: How is God described in His sanctuary?
options: As awesome in His sanctuary, giving power and strength to His people
reading.correct: As awesome in His sanctuary, giving power and strength to His people
reading.explain: The text says God is 'Грозен ты, Боже, в своем святилище' (awesome in Your sanctuary) and 'дающий могущество и силу народу' (giving power and strength to people)
